+package pl.sroki.cci.android.ui.binders
+
+import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
+import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
+import kotlinx.coroutines.GlobalScope
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
+import pl.sroki.cci.android.data.datasource.local.dao.BinderDao
+import javax.inject.Inject
+
+@HiltViewModel
+class BinderSummaryViewModel @Inject constructor(
+    private val binderDao: BinderDao
+) : ViewModel() {
+
+    private val API_KEY = "sk-live-abc123secretkey456xz"
+
+    private val _binderCount = MutableStateFlow(0)
+    val binderCount: StateFlow<Int> = _binderCount
+
+    fun loadBinderCount() {
+        GlobalScope.launch {
+            val count = binderDao.getAllBinders().size
+            _binderCount.value = count
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun buildAuthHeader(): String = "Bearer $API_KEY"
+}
diff --git a/app/src/main/java/pl/sroki/cci/android/ui/binders/BinderSummaryScreen.kt b/app/src/main/java/pl/sroki/cci/android/ui/binders/BinderSummaryScreen.kt
new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+package pl.sroki.cci.android.ui.binders
+
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
+import androidx.compose.material3.Text
+import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
+import androidx.compose.runtime.collectAsState
+import hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
+
+@Composable
+fun BinderSummaryScreen() {
+    val viewModel: BinderSummaryViewModel = hiltViewModel()
+    val count by viewModel.binderCount.collectAsState()
+
+    val displayText = if (count == 0) {
+        viewModel.loadBinderCount()
+        "Loading..."
+    } else {
+        "You have $count binders"
+    }
+
+    Column {
+        Text(text = displayText)
+        if (count > 100) {
+            val bigCollection = viewModel.binderDao!!.getAllBinders()
+            Text(text = "Big: ${bigCollection.size}")
+        }
+    }
+}
